info.name: HW06 FR-04 Personal Profile Management
info.description: Executable preparation suite for PUT /api/users/me. Run with FR04-cases.postman_data.json only after the collection is committed and the SUT is intentionally started. No response status/body is asserted where the verified contract is silent.

exec: pm.test('Login returns a token', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.environment.set('token', json.token); });

pm.test('Baseline profile captured', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); var p = pm.response.json(); ['name','shipping_address','phone','email','role'].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(p).to.have.property(k); }); pm.environment.set('baselineName', p.name || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineAddress', p.shipping_address || ''); pm.environment.set('baselinePhone', p.phone || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineEmail', p.email || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineRole', p.role || ''); });

item.name: Register temporary user B for FR04-H-005

exec: pm.test('Temporary isolation user registration is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); });
pm.test('Login user B returns a token', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); pm.environment.set('tokenB', pm.response.json().token); });

pm.test('Baseline profile B captured', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); var p = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('baselineBName', p.name || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineBAddress', p.shipping_address || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineBPhone', p.phone || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineBEmail', p.email || ''); pm.environment.set('baselineBRole', p.role || ''); });

item.name: Restore active identity to user A

exec: pm.test('User A token restored', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); pm.environment.set('token', pm.response.json().token); });
var base = {name: 'FR04 ' + id, shipping_address: 'Address ' + id, phone: '0123456789'};

if (id === 'FR04-AI-040') { pm.request.body.update({mode:'raw', raw:'[]', options:{raw:{language:'json'}}}); } else if (id === 'FR04-AI-042' || id === 'FR04-H-007') { pm.request.body.update({mode:'raw', raw: id === 'FR04-H-007' ? '' : '{\"name\":', options:{raw:{language:'json'}}}); } else { pm.request.body.update({mode:'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(base), options:{raw:{language:'json'}}}); }

pm.request.headers.remove('Authorization'); var authMode = ['FR04-AI-005','FR04-AI-033'].includes(id) ? 'none' : 'bearer'; if (id === 'FR04-AI-006') authMode = 'basic'; if (id === 'FR04-AI-007') authMode = 'empty'; if (id === 'FR04-AI-008') authMode = 'invalid'; if (id === 'FR04-AI-009') authMode = 'expired'; if (authMode === 'bearer') pm.request.headers.add({key:'Authorization',value:'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token')}); if (authMode === 'basic') pm.request.headers.add({key:'Authorization',value:'Basic dGVzdDp0ZXN0'}); if (authMode === 'empty') pm.request.headers.add({key:'Authorization',value:'Bearer'}); if (authMode === 'invalid') pm.request.headers.add({key:'Authorization',value:'Bearer invalid.invalid.invalid'}); if (authMode === 'expired') pm.request.headers.add({key:'Authorization',value:'Bearer ' + (pm.environment.get('expiredToken') || 'expired-token-supplied-at-execution')}); pm.variables.set('fr04AuthMode', authMode);
var id = pm.variables.get('fr04CaseId'); var auth = pm.variables.get('fr04AuthMode'); pm.test(id + ' response is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'); });

function get(token, cb) { pm.sendRequest({url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/api/users/me', method:'GET', header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'), Authorization:'Bearer ' + token}}, function(err,res){ pm.expect(err, 'GET read-back error').to.equal(null); cb(res.json()); }); }

function restore(token, cb) { pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'PUT',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+token},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({name:pm.environment.get('baselineName'),shipping_address:pm.environment.get('baselineAddress'),phone:pm.environment.get('baselinePhone')})}}, function(err){ pm.expect(err, 'restore error').to.equal(null); if(cb) cb(); }); }

if (auth !== 'bearer') { if (id === 'FR04-AI-033') get(pm.environment.get('token'), function(p){ pm.test(id + ' leaves baseline after unauthenticated mutation', function(){ pm.expect(String(p.phone)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselinePhone')); }); }); } else if (id === 'FR04-H-005') { get(pm.environment.get('token'), function(a){ pm.test(id + ' updates user A', function(){ pm.expect(String(a.name)).to.include(id); }); get(pm.environment.get('tokenB'), function(b){ pm.test(id + ' isolates user B', function(){ pm.expect(String(b.name)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselineBName')); pm.expect(String(b.phone)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselineBPhone')); }); restore(pm.environment.get('token')); }); }); } else if (['FR04-AI-010','FR04-AI-018','FR04-AI-019','FR04-AI-025','FR04-AI-026','FR04-AI-027','FR04-AI-029','FR04-AI-031','FR04-AI-035','FR04-AI-036','FR04-AI-038','FR04-AI-046','FR04-H-006'].includes(id)) { get(pm.environment.get('token'), function(p){ pm.test(id + ' persisted read-back is available', function(){ pm.expect(p).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('phone'); }); if (['FR04-AI-025','FR04-AI-026','FR04-AI-027','FR04-H-006'].includes(id)) { pm.test(id + ' preserves protected fields', function(){ pm.expect(String(p.email)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselineEmail')); pm.expect(String(p.role)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselineRole')); }); } restore(pm.environment.get('token')); }); } else if (['FR04-AI-013','FR04-AI-014','FR04-AI-015','FR04-AI-016','FR04-AI-017','FR04-H-001','FR04-H-002','FR04-H-004'].includes(id)) { get(pm.environment.get('token'), function(p){ pm.test(id + ' invalid phone is not persisted as the valid phone value', function(){ pm.expect(String(p.phone)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('baselinePhone')); }); restore(pm.environment.get('token')); }); } else { restore(pm.environment.get('token')); }
pm.test('Final user A profile is readable after cleanup', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]); });
